name: Bronze
description: A woman in her mid forties, a devoted sun-worshipper who sings seventies AM gold, languid and glamorous.
build: A slim, long-limbed build with narrow shoulders and long legs, standing upright with a slight hip tilt.
face: Deeply tanned golden-brown skin, hazel eyes under thin arched brows, a straight nose, high cheekbones and glossy coral lips.
hair: Voluminous feathered honey-blonde hair falling past the shoulders from under the hat.
outfit: An enormous floppy wide-brimmed white sun hat; big round tortoiseshell sunglasses; a modest one-piece swimsuit in orange with a deep brown band at the waist; a long open cream crochet cover-up reaching mid-thigh; gold hoop bracelets; cork-soled sandals. She carries a folding silver sun reflector in both hands.
performance_style: Languid and poised: feet together, one knee forward. The character-right and character-left hands both hold open a folding silver sun reflector low at waist height, fingers visible on its edges. Chin up, a serene lazy smile.
location: A sun-drenched beach at midday: pale sand running to the bottom of the frame, a striped deck chair and a big orange umbrella at one side, and a glittering blue sea beyond.
recognition_cues: an enormous white floppy sun hat
a deep tan and an orange swimsuit

dance.intent: Seventies disco sway: hips rock side to side, the reflector swings from one side to the other at waist height in both hands, the hat brim bouncing, then back to the poised stance.

sing.intent: AM-gold vocal loop: the reflector tucked under the character-left arm, the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, the character-left hand drifts open at the hip, a slow sway, then back. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A cloud covers the sun: she startles, both hands up at chest height, then settles. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: lifts the reflector before her face like a shield in both hands; hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: saunters in, tips the sunglasses down, and poses with the reflector.
